Definition: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: 1) light; 1a) light of day; 1b) light of heavenly luminaries (moon, sun, stars); 1c) day-break, dawn, morning light; 1d) daylight; 1e) lightning; 1f) light of lamp; 1g) light of life; 1h) light of prosperity; 1i) light of instruction; 1j) light of face (fig.); 1k) Jehovah as Israel's light
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
